g.text: Copying as a bounded predictive model
Past words only · Nonempty full-word probabilities · EOS + finite-universe escape · Frozen development choices
Calibration: 20 seeds per order and representation, each independently refitted. Native generator paragraph markers were logged without changing output.
The model detects these Timm controls; manuscript gains are small and transcription-sensitive. Neither result deciphers meaning.
